Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.6 "Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise" Special Program
🕙2026/09/20 19:30 (UTC+8)
The Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.6 "Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise" Special Program will release on 2026/09/20 at 19:30 (UTC+8).

This program will be broadcast from the official livestream studio. The new version will bring you a Trailblaze Continuance where the moonlight bends and the beast begins to dance — with new characters, new stages, and a preview of what awaits beyond the moonrise.
Follow our official channels to keep up with news on the latest version!
